candidates.change_summary: Remove the require overflow check on balances update, which can cause silent overflows that revert in the original but proceed in the mutant.
Change the deposit condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit, altering the behavior when exactly MinDeposit is sent.
Replace balances[msg.sender] with a different address in the balance update, causing the deposit to affect a fixed address instead of the caller.
Replace the require safety check with require(false), making all deposits revert that would otherwise succeed above the threshold.
Delete the entire if guard so deposit always updates balance regardless of msg.value, changing balances for deposits <= MinDeposit.
Change the CashOut balance guard from <= to <, so cashing out exactly the full balance is rejected and balances are unchanged.
Change subtraction to addition in the CashOut balance update, so a successful cash-out increases the caller's balance instead of decreasing it.
Drop the .call{value: _am}("") external value transfer, so CashOut only records state and log changes without sending ether.
Change the call-success check to always log by testing true instead of _veri_ok, affecting logging behavior after a failed low-level call.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage call in the success branch, so successful cash-outs no longer append a history entry.
Delete the revert in the failed-call else branch, so a failed ether transfer leaves the balance deducted without reverting the state change.
Change the CashOut guard from `_am <= balances[msg.sender]` to `_am < balances[msg.sender]`, causing withdrawal of the entire balance to revert.
Delete the balance subtraction so the caller's balance is never reduced, making repeated CashOut calls succeed without prior state change.
Change the logged CashOut value from `_am` to `0`, altering externally observable log data when the transfer succeeds.
Move the balance subtraction to after the external call, enabling reentrant CashOut before the caller's balance is reduced.
Move the external call to before the `_veri_ok` check and log update, so the log is written after the state update, changing timing of the external call.
